Pontoatelier is an architecture office based in Madeira Island, led by the architects Ana Ferreira and Pedro Ribeiro.The practice has developed a wide range of projects, from houses or urban planning to scenographies and furniture.Ponto is interested in the materialization of ideas in the most diverse forms.They combine professional activities such as projects, competitions, exhibitions with research and academic commitment.
They were invited to join the national committee at the 2019 Iberoamerican Bienal. And one of the five architecture studios invited to participate in the national curatorship contest for La Biennale di Venezia 2020.

Branco Del-Rio is an architecture studio based in Coimbra. Involved in projects of various scales, we seek and encourage solutions that elevate our relationship with space. Paula del Rio. Soria,1985 Studied architecture at the Technical School of Architecture of Madrid between 2003 and 2010, where she studied the Master en Proyectos Arquitectónicos Avanzados in 2011, when she also started her teaching career as an assistant professor in the chair of Juan Carlos Sancho teaching design of fourth and fifth course. She is currently developing her PhD thesis entitled "La identidad como concepto clave en la ciudad de finales del Siglo XX". Her professional career has developed as a collaborator in the offices of Francisco Mangado in Pamplona and Sancho-Madridejos in Madrid. She ir currently invited Assistant in Design I Studio (1st year) at Darq UC, Coimbra. João Branco. Coimbra, 1983 Studied architecture at the Department of Architecture of the University of Coimbra and ETSA in Barcelona between 2001 and 2008. He studied the Máster en Proyectos Arquitectónicos Avanzados in the departamento de proyectos at the UMP ETSAM in Madrid in 2011 where he teached as a professor assistant in the chair of Juan Carlos Sancho. In 2014 he finished the Energy for Sustainability (EfS) postgraduate studies, an initiative of the University of Coimbra in partnership with MIT Portugal Program. Between 2008 and 2010 he worked in the offices of Jorge Teixeira Dias, BAAS, Jordi Badia and João Mendes Ribeiro. He began working independently in 2011. He currently develops a PhD Thesis in Darq UC, Coimbra, he is a junior reseracher in CES (Centro de Estudos Sociais). In 2018-2019 course he was a Guest Assistant in Design Studio II A (5th year) with Paulo Providência.

The [N2X] team started it’s activity in the year 2004, comprising of Isabel Ourique and Pedro Furtado, both of which studied at Faculty of Architecture on the Technical University of Lisbon between 1997 and 2003. Constant collaborators between 2003 and 2006 in various offices in Lisbon, they now practice their activity in Ponta Delgada, in the Island of S. Miguel, Azores. Architecture in it’s practical current has become the priority and objective of this team. We look for valid ideas that have solid foundation on concepts. We experiment through drawings and detail, the reflection of the modulation of spaces built that transmit simplicity and pragmatism.

Silverline is an architecture and construction studio founded in 2008 by Jorge Prata and Eduardo Soares, based in Vila Nova de Gaia. Rooted in the belief that design and execution should form a single, cohesive process, Silverline delivers integrated solutions through a close collaboration between its architecture and construction teams.
Each project is approached as a unique response to its physical, social, and cultural context, balancing formal precision with functional clarity and emotional depth. The studio engages contemporary challenges by rethinking ways of living and the dialogue between public and private space.
Strategic partnerships — including an ongoing collaboration with Melt81 Studio — enrich Silverline’s design approach, reinforcing its commitment to crafting architectural experiences that are thoughtful, enduring, and human-centered.
